items.text: I tried to send five thousand rupees to Amitabh but money was deducted
Payment to chatrapathi stores failed but the amount fifteen hundred got deducted
I transferred two hundred rupees to Priya on tenth february but it did not go through
Money of seven thousand five hundred was deducted for a failed payment to Ramesh
The UPI payment I did yesterday to hotel green leaf did not get completed but money got debited
I did a transaction for nine thousand rupees from my phone to Anjali but it failed

items.context: When did the failed transaction occur?
items.text: The transfer to Salim on 20th March did not complete but money left my account
I used the UPI on my phone but it showed payment failed with Ayush Stores

items.context: What amount was deducted during the failed transaction?
items.text: The amount of 2,300 rupees was deducted but the payment status showed failure

items.context: Please tell me the date and time of the transaction.
items.text: It was yesterday evening that I tried to pay vendor Ravi but the money wasn’t credited
I made a UPI payment of exactly twelve thousand rupees to my landlord Mr. Gupta on March 15th but the payment failed and the money was debited from my account
On the 3rd of February I attempted to transfer five thousand five hundred rupees to my friend Sahil but the transaction failed and I still haven’t received any refund

items.context: To assist you further can you provide details of the failed transaction like the beneficiary and amount?
items.text: I understand your frustration but can you confirm the name of the beneficiary and the amount paid

items.context: Can you please share your current account balance and transaction details for better assistance?
items.text: My account balance still shows that the amount of 8500 rupees has been deducted for the payment to shopkeeper Reddy on 10th March but the transaction status says failure

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: failed_upi_refund - a UPI or online payment failed but money was debited; wants a refund
Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
